# E-Perfect Beauty

> Natural-looking eyebrow, lip, and eyeliner embroidery and facial care in Singapore.

E-Perfect Beauty (also known as E Perfect Eyebrow Studio) is a boutique beauty studio in Singapore specializing in semi-permanent makeup and advanced skincare treatments. Lead by technician Evelyn, the studio focuses on enhancing natural features rather than creating a "templated" look.

## Core Services

### Embroidery
*   **Eyebrow Embroidery:** Personally mapped to bone structure and skin tone. Specializes in **Korean Misty Eyebrow** for a soft, powdery finish.
*   **Lip Embroidery:** Restores natural tint and symmetry for pale or uneven lips without a heavy lipstick appearance.
*   **Eyeliner Embroidery:** Subtle lash-line definition tailored to eye shape.
*   **Details:** [Pricing & Info](https://www.eperfectbeauty.com/pricing.html#embroidery)

### Anti-Wrinkle & Lifting
*   **Needle-Free Stem Cell Treatment:** Advanced skin renewal without injections or downtime.
*   **Anti-Laughline & Forehead Care:** Targeted, non-invasive treatments to soften expression lines.
*   **Face Lifting:** Focuses on restoring firm-looking contours and a rested appearance.
*   **Details:** [Pricing & Info](https://www.eperfectbeauty.com/pricing.html#anti-wrinkle)

### Facials & Whitening
*   **Hydra Aqua Peel:** Deep cleansing and gentle exfoliation using hydra technology for clogged pores and uneven texture.
*   **Hydra Glow Booster:** Intensive hydration for dehydrated skin or event preparation.
*   **Needle-Free Whitening Treatment:** Clinically tested treatment targeting melanin and dark spots to improve luminosity and even tone.
*   **Details:** [Pricing & Info](https://www.eperfectbeauty.com/pricing.html#facials)

## Specialities & Features

*   **Natural Aesthetics:** The primary philosophy is "results that still look like you." Treatments avoid "blocky" or "frozen" looks.
*   **Bespoke Mapping:** Embroidery is never based on a template; it is mapped to the individual's face shape and bone structure.
*   **Needle-Free Innovation:** Offers advanced anti-wrinkle and whitening results without the use of needles.
*   **Personalized Consultations:** Direct access to Evelyn via WhatsApp for honest advice, photo assessments, and no-obligation quotes before booking.
*   **Experience-Led:** Evelyn has years of hands-on experience in pigment healing and skin types, ensuring long-term wearable results.

## Frequently Asked Questions
*   **Darkness after embroidery:** Brows soften after a few days.
*   **Pain:** Minimal, most clients find it very manageable.
*   **Fixing old work:** Often possible, assessment via WhatsApp.
*   **Duration:** Semi-permanent, varies by skin type.
